children: Overview
US regional bank's fiscal Q4 net income and EPS declined sequentially
Fiscal 2026 EPS rose 22% yr/yr, with improved asset quality metrics
Net interest income and margin were stable compared to previous quarter
Outlook
Company expects to benefit from rising rates as assets reprice faster than liabilities
WaFd anticipates a net gain of about $7 mln from multifamily loan sale in Q1 fiscal 2027
Result Drivers
LOAN SALES - WaFd said Q4 non-interest income rose due to gains from sale of single-family residential loans
ASSET QUALITY IMPROVEMENT - Co said asset quality metrics improved, citing resolution of a large classified loan and decreases in non-performing assets and delinquencies
MERGER COSTS - WaFd said Q4 non-interest expense increased due to strategic investments and merger-related costs

Analyst Coverage

The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for WaFd Inc is $35.50, about 20.5% above its October 15 closing price of $29.45
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
